summary: Build practical mentoring, sponsorship and knowledge transfer skills with templates, trackers, and scorecards. Enrol now to improve continuity and talent mobili
lede: Mentoring, sponsorship and knowledge transfer combine structured learning relationships, advocacy for opportunity, and explicit capture of expertise. For HR, learning, talent and line-management professionals, these practices help identify knowledge risks and build repeatable handovers within existing workflows. The course covers readiness assessments, sponsor pathways, mentoring agreements, knowledge-transfer packs and ways to track whether learning is retained.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you shape talent development, succession, or knowledge continuity and need practical tools that work inside real organizational constraints. HR Business Partners who support capability, succession, and internal mobility. Learning and Development Specialists who design mentoring and transfer interventions. Talent Development Managers who oversee mentoring and sponsorship pipelines. Line Managers who need structured knowledge handover and growth support. Knowledge Management Specialists who document tacit expertise and lessons learned. Succession Planning Leads who reduce role dependency and readiness risk. Organisational Development Practitioners shaping learning culture and capability continuity. People Analytics Analysts tracking participation, mobility, and retention indicators. Senior Leaders sponsoring future talent and reviewing programme evidence. Project Managers handing over critical process knowledge across teams.
modules: Mentoring, sponsorship and knowledge transfer foundations
prerequisites: Bring a laptop and access to common office tools such as Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint or equivalent collaboration software. You should also bring one real example of a role, process, or team where critical knowledge, succession risk, or mentoring demand is currently visible.
